Unable to identify this computer’s desktop shortcuts. Check the connection and update the ClipRelay host.

Desktop navigation: swipe left / right with three fingers to switch virtual desktops, or four fingers to switch displays. Left goes to the next one; right goes to the previous one. Lift all fingers to finish. Displays cycle in list order; desktop switching requires existing desktops and the system’s default shortcuts (Windows or macOS). These gestures are disabled in game mode. If Android intercepts a three-finger screenshot gesture, turn that shortcut off in the device settings.
